total_supply.meaning: totalSupply value of the vault, set by the constructor to 1,000,000 shares

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] over all accounts, i.e. shares actually minted to holders

assets_released_per_share.meaning: assets released by a redemption per share redeemed, computed with totalSupply as denominator

fair_assets_per_share.meaning: assets per share that would be released if the denominator reflected only backed shares

assumptions: The 1,000,000 ghost shares are never later minted to or burned from any account, so sum(balanceOf[]) stays below totalSupply.
The withdrawal path uses totalSupply as the redemption denominator, as stated for the key redemption formula.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of fair_assets_per_share or of the assets released per share, so the under-payment magnitude cannot be computed; only the qualitative direction (fewer assets per share) is stated.
Report does not state whether the constructor's totalSupply assignment is intentional or erroneous, nor whether ghost shares are ever later minted or burned.

limitations: Conservation is expressed at the share-accounting level (totalSupply vs sum of balances) plus the qualitative per-share under-payment direction; no concrete asset amounts are given.
No attacker transaction is described; the ghost shares originate in the constructor, so no action step is modeled.
Only the withdrawals_under_pay impact is formalized here; deposits_over_mint and value_skimmed_permanently are handled in separate passes.
